```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## Load Libraries

```{r load-libraries}
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
# library(plotly)
```

## Load Data

```{r load-data}
data_file <- '../data/Lawler_2020/GSE157359_rna_fullCountMatrix.txt.gz'
meta_file <- '../data/Lawler_2020/processed/lawler_10x_format/metadata.csv'

# Load count matrix
count_data <- read.table(data_file, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = '\t')

# Load metadata
metadata <- read.csv(meta_file, row.names = 1)

# Ensure count data and metadata have matching samples
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(count_data), rownames(metadata))
count_data <- count_data[, common_samples]
metadata <- metadata[common_samples, ]

# Convert count data to integer matrix (required for DESeq2)
count_matrix <- as.matrix(count_data)
count_matrix <- apply(count_matrix, 2, as.integer)
rownames(count_matrix) <- rownames(count_data)

print(paste("Number of genes:", nrow(count_matrix)))
print(paste("Number of samples:", ncol(count_matrix)))
```

## Data Overview

```{r data-overview}
# Display metadata structure
head(metadata)

# Sample distribution
table(metadata$pv_status, metadata$brain_region)
table(metadata$treatment, metadata$brain_region)
```

## Create DESeq2 Object

```{r create-deseq-object}
if (!file.exists("../data/Lawler_2020/processed/DDS_GSE157359_rna_fullCountMatrix.rds")){
  
  # Create DESeq2 dataset object
  # Using a simple design for exploratory analysis
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = count_matrix,
    colData = metadata,
    design = ~ brain_region + treatment + pv_status
  )

  # Filter low count genes (keep genes with at least 10 reads in at least 3 samples)
  keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3
  dds <- dds[keep, ]
  
} else {
  
  # Read from previously back-up'ed object
  dds <- readRDS("../data/Lawler_2020/processed/DDS_GSE157359_rna_fullCountMatrix.rds")
  
}

print(paste("Genes retained after filtering:", nrow(dds)))
```

## Exploratory Data Analysis

### Library Size Distribution

```{r library-sizes}
# Calculate library sizes
lib_sizes <- colSums(counts(dds))
metadata$library_size <- lib_sizes

# Plot library sizes
ggplot(metadata, aes(x = reorder(rownames(metadata), library_size), y = library_size)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = brain_region)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Library Sizes by Sample",
       x = "Samples", y = "Total Counts") +
  scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Set2")
```

### Variance Stabilizing Transformation

```{r vst-transformation}
# Apply variance stabilizing transformation
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)

# Extract transformed counts
vst_counts <- assay(vsd)
```

### Sample Distance Heatmap

```{r sample-distances, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
# Calculate sample distances
sampleDists <- dist(t(vst_counts))
sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix(sampleDists)

# Create annotation for heatmap
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  PV_Status = metadata$pv_status,
  Brain_Region = metadata$brain_region,
  Treatment = metadata$treatment,
  row.names = rownames(metadata)
)

# Plot heatmap
pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix,
         clustering_distance_rows = sampleDists,
         clustering_distance_cols = sampleDists,
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         main = "Sample Distance Heatmap")
```

```{r}
# Combined PCA plot with ellipses
p3 <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = interaction(pv_status, treatment), shape = brain_region), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(brewer.pal(n=12, name="Paired")[c(4,6,3,5)],"#00929b","#7a1290","#ff4b00")) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = brain_region), type = "norm", linetype = 2, size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  guides(shape = "none") +
  labs(title = "PV Status × Treatment × Brain Region",
       x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
       y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p3
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "lawler_pv_PCA.svg",
  plot = p3,
  path = "../figures/label_transfer/",
  width = 8, height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)
```

### Top Variable Genes Heatmap

```{r variable-genes-heatmap, fig.width=8, fig.height=10}
# Select top 50 most variable genes
topVarGenes <- head(order(rowVars(vst_counts), decreasing = TRUE), 50)

# Create heatmap of top variable genes
pheatmap(vst_counts[topVarGenes, ],
         scale = "row",
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         main = "Top 50 Most Variable Genes")
```

## Summary

```{r summary}
cat("Data Summary:\n")
cat("- Total genes after filtering:", nrow(dds), "\n")
cat("- Total samples:", ncol(dds), "\n")
cat("- Brain regions:", paste(unique(metadata$brain_region), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("- Treatments:", paste(unique(metadata$treatment), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("- PV status groups:", paste(unique(metadata$pv_status), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("\nPCA Results:\n")
cat("- PC1 explains", percentVar[1], "% of variance\n")
cat("- PC2 explains", percentVar[2], "% of variance\n")
cat("- Total variance explained by PC1+PC2:", sum(percentVar[1:2]), "%\n")
```
